name: NOWPayments
description_short: Payment gateway for ada payments and donations.
description_long: Non-custodial crypto payment gateway supporting ada alongside 350+ cryptocurrencies and 75+ fiat currencies. Merchants and creators can accept payments through invoices, a payment button or widget, point-of-sale, subscriptions, donation tools, e-commerce plugins, or a developer API, with optional auto-conversion and fiat off-ramp payouts. Fees are 0.5% for single-currency payments and 1% with conversion. Not Cardano-specific — ada is one of many supported assets. Launched by ChangeNOW in 2019, processing over 30 million transactions a month.
